name: Tegwyll's Scouring
oracle_text:
You may cast this spell as though it had flash by tapping three untapped creatures you control with flying in addition to paying its other costs.
Destroy all creatures. Create three 1/1 black Faerie Rogue creature tokens with flying.
blocked_sentences: You may cast this spell as though it had flash by tapping three untapped creatures you control with flying in addition to paying its other costs.
Create three 1/1 black Faerie Rogue creature tokens with flying.

needs.what: a card-level timing permission that lets the spell be cast as though it had flash ONLY when an extra cost is paid -- here a `tap_permanents` of three untapped creatures you control with flying ({"types": ["Creature"], "keywords": ["flying"], "count": 3}) on top of the mana cost -- e.g. a `flash_cost` node from `cost_keys` beside `as_though_flash`; at sorcery timing the spell is cast normally without that cost, outside it the cast is legal only by paying it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `as_though_flash` is an unconditional boolean rider (schema `as_though_flash: bool`), so setting it would let the sweeper be cast at instant speed for free -- strictly better than the printed card. `additional_cost`/`additional_optional` charge a cost at any timing but do not widen timing, and nothing ties a paid additional cost to `casting._timing_ok`; `cast_as_though_flash` statics and `grant_flash_permission` are permissions from another source with board-only conditions. The tap cost itself (`tap_permanents` with a flying filter) already exists; only the link between paying it and flash timing is missing

needs.what: a 1/1 black Faerie Rogue creature token with flying
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `token_ids` has `faerie_1_1_u_flying` (blue, Faerie only), `bat_1_1_b_flying`, `insect_1_1_b_flying` and `vampire_rogue_1_1_b_lifelink`, none of which is a black Faerie Rogue with flying; the same token is already recorded by shadow_puppeteers
